name: app-shell
title: App shell: agent layer
description: AgentLayer: one agent's PiChat above the app. On a phone a bottom drawer with three fixed snap points (peek above the tab bar, half, full; a swipe never closes it, the transcript scrolls and only the handle drags, the composer lifts above the soft keyboard); on a wide screen a right panel. The same layer shows the product manager (improve) when the account menu asks for it. Optional push-to-talk (press and hold the AgentTrigger or the hero button; the transcript is sent or fills the composer) and point mode for the manager. Also useAgentContext and readAgentContext (the current screen travels as `context` with each submit) and useBackLayer, the one Back manager. A minimal reset scoped to the layer's own elements stands in for Tailwind's preflight. Built on the shadcn drawer and sidebar of the host's own style (Base UI variants).
